parameters.content:
## Stage 1: Inbound IVR
Twilio's Voice webhook for the client's number points at the "Inbound Call" webhook below.

Flow:
1. Call arrives -> greeting + Gather (Press 1 / Press 2)
2. Twilio POSTs the pressed digit to "Gather Result"
3. Digit 1 -> <Dial> straight to reception (pure Twilio forwarding, no AI)
4. Digit 2 -> <Dial><Sip> handoff to the Vapi assistant (see README for Vapi SIP Trunking setup)

Set the Twilio number's Voice webhook (in the Twilio Console, or via the Twilio node) to:
https://keystoneconsultancy.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/twilio/inbound-call

assignments.name: twiml
assignments.value:
=<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Gather numDigits="1" timeout="6" action="https://keystoneconsultancy.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/twilio/gather-result" method="POST">
    <Say voice="Polly.Amy-Neural" language="en-GB">{{ ($json.greeting || ('Thanks for calling ' + $json.businessName + '.')).replace(/&/g, 'and').replace(/</g, '') }} Press 1 to speak to the team. Press 2 to book, reschedule or get a price estimate.</Say>
  </Gather>
  <Say voice="Polly.Amy-Neural" language="en-GB">Putting you through to the team now.</Say>
  <Dial>{{ $json.receptionForwardNumber }}</Dial>
</Response>

nodes.name: Merge Call Context
nodes.notes: Combines the Client Config output with the caller's raw Twilio params (available via $('Gather Result')) since Execute Workflow replaces the item's json. Was a Set node that only kept digits/callerNumber/calledNumber and silently dropped every Client Config field (receptionForwardNumber, vapiSipCredentialId, vapiSipRegionHost, clientId, etc) - converted to a Code node with an explicit spread so the Vapi handoff SIP URI and reception forwarding actually get real values instead of resolving to empty strings.

assignments.name: twiml
assignments.value:
=<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Say voice="Polly.Amy-Neural" language="en-GB">Connecting you now.</Say>
  <Dial>{{ $json.receptionForwardNumber }}</Dial>
</Response>

nodes.name: Build Vapi Handoff TwiML
nodes.notes: REQUIRES VALIDATION IN TESTING: dynamic <Dial><Sip> handoff mid-call to Vapi's SIP trunking URI. Set up the SIP trunking phone number + credential in the Vapi dashboard first (see README). The Dial's action callback (Dial Status Callback node below) catches a failed handoff (busy/no-answer/failed/canceled) and falls back to forwarding the caller to reception instead of dropping the call, plus emails the business with the specific DialCallStatus so a failure is never silent.

assignments.name: twiml
assignments.value:
=<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Dial answerOnBridge="true" action="https://keystoneconsultancy.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/twilio/vapi-dial-status" method="POST">
    <Sip>
      {{ $json.vapiSipUri ? $json.vapiSipUri : ('sip:' + $json.calledNumber + '@' + $json.vapiSipCredentialId + '.' + $json.vapiSipRegionHost) }}
      <Parameter name="clientId" value="{{ $json.clientId }}" />
      <Parameter name="callerNumber" value="{{ $json.callerNumber }}" />
    </Sip>
  </Dial>
</Response>

assignments.name: twiml
assignments.value:
=<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Say voice="Polly.Amy-Neural" language="en-GB">Let me put you through to the team.</Say>
  <Dial>{{ $json.receptionForwardNumber }}</Dial>
</Response>

parameters.content:
## SIP Handoff Failure Handling
Twilio calls this back automatically after the Vapi <Dial> leg ends, whatever the outcome (DialCallStatus: completed / busy / no-answer / failed / canceled).

- completed -> the call already ended normally (Vapi/caller hung up); just acknowledge, no further TwiML has any effect.
- anything else -> the SIP handoff itself failed to connect. The caller is still on the line waiting, so we recover instead of dropping them: forward to reception, and email the business immediately with the exact DialCallStatus + CallSid so a failure is never silent or vague.

This is the fallback + logging asked for around the SIP handoff risk - it does not remove the risk itself (still unverified against a real call), it just makes a failure recoverable and visible instead of a dropped call with no trace.

nodes.name: Notify Business Of Failed Handoff
nodes.notes: Resend API - POST /emails. Uses the 'Header Auth account 2' credential (header Authorization: Bearer <resend-api-key>). onError continues regardless - the caller must still get the fallback TwiML even if this notification itself fails to send.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { twiml: $('Build SIP-Failure Fallback TwiML').item.json.twiml } }];
